about_the_game:
Serena ended up all alone in the middle of nowhere... in the dead of the night. She just wants to get home. But sometimes you got to make the best out of the worst.

Story

Serena saw a decrepit house, but the lights were on so she decided to knock. What comes after is a series of decisions that might alter her in unimaginable ways. Come explore with us some creative ways to make her night a little bit harder.

Gameplay

You choose Serena's path and decide together with the Scientist what experiments she will participate in. The experiments all have a way of making things sexy, so explore the options and decide the best (or worst) course of action. Three new branches were added to the game, expanding even more on the escapades Serena can get into.

Features

  • You can replay any path and decision you discovered by selecting it on the Roadmap in the Extras menu.
  • Visit the Gallery in the Extras menu to check out all the scenes you unlocked during your gameplay. Can you find them all?
  • The text speed and auto delay can be adjusted in the Settings menu.
  • Use the Skip/Auto button in-game to automatically advance the dialogue without clicking each time or hold down CTRL for the same effect.

Disclaimer
All digital characters depicted in this game are 18+

content_descriptors.notes:
This game involves the depiction of graphic sexual events. The sexual content includes straight and lesbian sex. If you are easily offended or of a delicate sensibility this game is not for you.
